# Upgrowplan

> AI business plan generator and market research platform that validates before it generates. Upgrowplan combines AI market simulation on synthetic respondents, live market research from 50+ verified sources, UNIDO/EBRD-standard business plan generation, and deterministic Python financial modelling — every figure is source-linked and Skeptic-Agent verified to avoid hallucinations. Founded 2024 in Tel Aviv. Interface and content available in English and Russian (Russian mirror under /ru).

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Product category: AI business planning, AI market research, financial modelling, synthetic (virtual) focus groups.
- Methodology: business plans follow UNIDO (UN Industrial Development Organization) and EBRD (European Bank for Reconstruction and Development) standards. Financial calculations are deterministic Python, not probabilistic LLM output.
- Differentiator: "validation before generation" — synthetic respondent testing + RAG on live data + a Skeptic Agent that flags unrealistic assumptions.
- Team has co-authored 230+ real business plans and feasibility studies.

## Tools
- [MarketSense — AI Market Research](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/marketResearch): Competitor mapping, market sizing, pricing trends from 50+ sources in ~15 minutes.
- [PlanMaster — Business Plan Generator](https://www.upgrowplan.com/ai-business-plan-generator): UNIDO/EBRD business plans with verified financials.
- [Synth Focus Lab — Virtual Focus Groups](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/synthFocusLab): AI synthetic respondents for concept, pricing, and messaging testing.
- [Synthetic Customer Research](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/synthetic-customer-research): Test demand and objections on virtual buyers built from real market patterns.
- [Business Pulse — Competitor Monitoring](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/businessPulse): Daily AI monitoring of competitors and market signals with weekly digest.
- [FinPilot — Financial Modelling (free)](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/fin-buddy): P&L, cash flow, break-even, 3-year projections on deterministic Python calculations.
- [Open Abroad — International Expansion (free)](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/openAbroad): Country comparison, tax and regulatory overview, market-entry strategy for 50+ countries.
- [Social Plan Master — Social Media Strategy](https://www.upgrowplan.com/solutions/socialPlanMaster): Data-driven content plans and platform recommendations.

## Blog
- [Blog](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog): Guides and analysis on AI business planning, market research, financial modelling, and startup validation.
- [How to write a business plan for investors (UNIDO)](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/how-to-write-business-plan-investors-unido): Investor-plan structure and methodology.
- [AI market research vs traditional research](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/ai-market-research-vs-traditional): How AI-driven research compares on speed, cost, and depth.
- [How Upgrowplan's RAG architecture works](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/how-upgrowplan-rag-works): Technical explanation of the validation pipeline.
- [Coffee shop in Milan: real market research (2026)](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/coffee-shop-milan-market-research-2026): Competitor prices, rent, margins and break-even for a café in Milan — verified data from 14 sources. TAM €2.1B, SAM €280M.
- [Financial stress-test for your business plan](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/financial-stress-test-business-plan-2026): 5 metrics investors check before funding: DSCR, LTV/CAC, runway, safety margin, cash gap. Includes "Hell Scenario" template.
- [Online English school market: competitor analysis 2026](https://www.upgrowplan.com/blog/online-english-school-market-2026-competitor-analysis): Global EdTech ELL market ($16B TAM), 30× price gap between FluentU ($29.99/mo) and Ginseng ($899/mo), pricing strategies of 12 competitors.
